## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests added or updated; CI green
- [ ] Threat-model impact considered (new input, new key, new exposure?)
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/adr/` if one was made
- [ ] Runbook or README updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Works on the synthetic demo tenant
- [ ] No real hosts, addresses, ids, names or secrets (scrub gate passes)
- [ ] Detection changes: tested against recorded events, approved by the owner
